_doc: The 22 required test scenarios. 'base' = ideal (perfect hardware) or nominal (Pixel as measured: ch7 dead, right side 5% faster, encoder L/R mismatch, noise). 'set' overrides parameters (number = set, {mul}/{add} = scale/offset). Each scenario runs on several seeds. Verdicts: PASS = parked with all 4 wheels inside PARK and route/turn checks clean; SAFE FAIL = firmware stopped itself with FAULT, on the route, motors off; FAIL = anything else.

scenarios.name: Ideal conditions
scenarios.means: all 8 channels work, no noise, symmetric motors and encoders

scenarios.name: Sensor channel 7 dead
scenarios.means: ideal, except channel 7 reads white always (as on Pixel)

scenarios.name: Sensor noise
scenarios.means: 5x the nominal ADC noise

scenarios.name: Encoder left disconnected
scenarios.means: left encoder never pulses

scenarios.name: Encoder right disconnected
scenarios.means: right encoder never pulses

scenarios.name: Both encoders disconnected
scenarios.means: no distance at all

scenarios.name: Gyro unavailable
scenarios.means: isHeadingReady() never true

scenarios.name: Gyro drift
scenarios.means: 0.5 deg/s drift (25x nominal)

scenarios.name: Left motor weaker
scenarios.means: left side 15% weaker

scenarios.name: Right motor weaker
scenarios.means: right side 10% weaker than left (instead of 5% stronger)

scenarios.name: Low motor speed
scenarios.means: both sides 25% slower (low battery); start thresholds unchanged

scenarios.name: High motor speed
scenarios.means: both sides 25% faster (fresh battery / lighter robot)

scenarios.name: Excessive motor ramp
scenarios.means: motors+chassis respond 3x slower. The firmware's own RAMP_RATE is NOT changed (that would be editing the controller)

scenarios.name: Incorrect start position
scenarios.means: placed 12 cm back and 3 cm left of the START centre

scenarios.name: Incorrect start heading
scenarios.means: placed turned 6 deg left

scenarios.name: Slight lateral sensor offset
scenarios.means: sensor bar mounted 6 mm left of the chassis centre line

scenarios.name: Starts too close to the edge of Start
scenarios.means: chassis 15 cm forward: sensor bar 2 cm from the box's front edge

scenarios.name: Intermittent line loss
scenarios.means: about once a second all channels read white for 50 ms

scenarios.name: Corner detected earlier than expected
scenarios.means: encoders under-count 8%: corners arrive ~15 cm before the firmware's prediction

scenarios.name: Corner detected later than expected
scenarios.means: encoders over-count 8%: corners arrive ~15 cm after the prediction

scenarios.name: Park Zone detected late
scenarios.means: PARK box 10 cm further from C4 than LAST_LEG_M says

scenarios.name: Robot overshoots the Park Zone
scenarios.means: long coast after stop() (slippery mat): the robot rolls on
